newsitem.title: USA: Shiva sees Q3 revenue growth challenged.
newsitem.headline: Shiva sees Q3 revenue growth challenged.

text.p: Shiva Corp, which provides remote access solutions, systems and services, said on Thursday that a seasonally slow summer in Europe could affect third quarter revenue growth.
"The seasonally slow summer sell-through in Europe will make third quarter revenue growth a challenge for us," Frank Ingari, Shiva chief executive said.
In its second quarter, Shiva reported a loss of $0.03 per share compared with a profit of $0.16 per share, which included a $0.06 per share acquisition cost.
Its revenues dropped to $39.7 million compared with $51.5 million in the year-ago quarter.

The company attributed the revenue decline mostly to lower sales of its fixed-port LanRover and non-remote access product lines, which were partially offset by higher revenues from the LanRover Access Switch products.
Shiva said these quarterly results were in line with its expectations.
But Ingari said: "We are pleased with several positive accomplishments during the quarter that we believe will provide us with the momentum to make real progress going forward."
These included various product announcements and the appointment of a new president, he said.
